summary: Implemented rule E3695 to validate ElastiCache CacheCluster engines. Added src/cfnlint/rules/resources/elasticache/CacheClusterEngine.py, the engine.json schema in src/cfnlint/data/schemas/extensions/aws_elasticache_cachecluster/ (allows memcached, redis, valkey), a unit test at test/unit/rules/resources/elasticache/test_cache_cluster_engine.py, and an E3695 row in docs/rules.md. Tests were not run, per the instructions, so the change is verified by reading only. Nothing is committed. Open choices: valkey is included (remove it if you want only memcached and redis), and engine matching is case-sensitive.
